The '''Utrost system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Coruscant sector/Legends|Coruscant sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utrost]].
